agent: speckit.taskstoissues

# Purpose

Convert QA tasks into backlog items for GitHub Issues, Azure DevOps, or Jira.

# Input

tasks.md

# Output

Generate issues.md

For each task include:

Title
Description
Acceptance Criteria
Priority
Labels
Assignee (if known)
Estimated Effort
Dependencies

The descriptions should be concise and ready to be copied into a work item tracker.
